spellbook.finance/limitations: Every count, market quote, seller response, payment and refund is submitted evidence. A payment marked customer_reported is not bank-verified.

Use evaluation.missingPricingCategories and null pricing/basis fields as unknowns, not zero. A completed deal records reconciliation of submitted observations; it is not a profit result or external settlement confirmation.
Physical custody does not mean title transfer. Inventory ownership and listing state come from their own SpellBook workflows.

description: Read the current snapshot or one immutable revision of a collection deal owned by the selected workspace. The response includes the selected revision's command and receiptId so submitted terms and corrections can be audited. Read the collection-buying skill before interpreting lifecycle state.

dealId.description: Exact dealId from a record or list response. Required.

revision.description: One immutable revision number. Omit for the latest snapshot.
